verdict.rationale: Lovable documents its own programmatic surface: an official Lovable MCP server lets an AI agent create projects, send messages, inspect code and deploy apps. A 'Lovable API Build with URL' feature also creates links that open Lovable with a prompt pre-filled. However, no general REST platform API is documented, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so programmatic generation and management depends on MCP clients and prefilled URLs rather than a full API. missing for 10: documented REST/HTTP platform API with an OpenAPI spec, API authentication/keys docs, endpoint-level project management detail, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate and manage apps programmatically through a platform API

citations.quote: your AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, deploy apps, and more, all without leaving the client you're already working in
The Lovable API Build with URL feature lets you create links that open Lovable with a prompt already written
